_readme: EVERY PENDING GO-LIVE VALUE LIVES IN THIS FILE.
Fill a value in and the element switches on. Leave it "" and the element is
removed from the page entirely, along with any container it would have left
empty. There is no href="#" fallback anywhere, so the worst case is a missing
link, never a dead one. Run `python3 build.py` after any change.
name: Irony vs. Satyr
description: A bottle shop in Nove Mesto, Prague. The whole shelf, listed - spirits chosen one at a time, by people who drink them.
_url_note: Where the site actually lives. Canonicals, og:url and sitemap.xml all derive from it, so pointing a real domain at Pages means changing this one line and rebuilding.

_readme: Required on a Czech business site and shown on privacy.html.
build.py names every one of these that is still blank, and the page
says so on itself rather than looking finished while incomplete.
This is a catalogue, not a shop: nothing is bought on the site.
availability_note appears on every product page and is a statement of
how the shop actually works, not decoration.
catalogue.availability_note: Prices are what you pay at the counter. Stock moves, so call ahead if you are making a trip for one bottle - and bring photo ID, we check it every time.

analytics._readme: Plausible only, cookieless. Leave blank for no analytics and nothing to disclose. Switching it on means the privacy page needs a line about it.
